name: Beholder (Variant Abilities)
subjectPrompt: A round levitating burgundy aberration with one dominant blue-violet central eye and jagged fanged maw. Exactly ten slender curled stalks, each with a clearly separate eye tip, five on the left and five on the right of the composition. A single upper-right eyestalk casts a short forked amber lightning arc curling into empty space. The lightning is a visual nod to the chain lightning alternative to its Disintegration Ray. Full silhouette, no arms, legs or body other than the levitating sphere.

name: Mind Flayer Lich (Illithilich)
subjectPrompt: Undead illithid wizard with elongated bald octopoid skull, gray-green mummified skin stretched on a gaunt face, four distinct withered tendrils sprouting around the mouth, hollow luminous lilac eyes, tall ragged weathered umber and charcoal ceremonial robes, one bony hand clutching a little obsidian phylactery. Full-length original pose. Use the second reference for standard illithid silhouette only and make this figure unmistakably ancient and undead.

name: Yuan-ti Anathema (Acid Slime)
subjectPrompt: Huge snake-bodied monster with a single robust serpentine trunk, two clawed arms and exactly six separate narrow cobra heads which visibly fan out from its shared upper torso. Mottled umber and orange scales, golden ochre belly, no robes. Clinging translucent yellow-green acid mucus strands dripping from the underside and hands, with a small acidic pooled smear below; readable six-headed silhouette.
